# Elements: Actions

> Plainkit 0.1.0-alpha.1. Generated by scripts/build-skills.mjs from core/dist/elements/api.json. Do not edit: change the source and run the generator.

Every element also takes the usual HTML global attributes (`id`, `class`, `slot`, `hidden`, `aria-*`, `data-*`). Never use a `style` attribute (the CSP blocks it): use props, parts and CSS custom properties.

## `pk-button`

**Button** (Actions). A button in five variants and three sizes, with busy, icon-only and toggle forms. type="submit" and "reset" act on the surrounding form, as a native button does.

It is form-associated (takes part in a `<form>` by its `name`) and delegates focus to its inner control.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `variant` | enum | `"primary"` | `primary` `ghost` `warn` `secondary` `plain` | Visual weight. |
| `size` | `size` | enum | `"md"` | `md` `mini` `lg` | md is the reading-size control; mini is the compact desktop-density one; lg is the large one. |
| `type` | `type` | enum | `"button"` | `button` `submit` `reset` | What a click does inside a form: nothing, submit it, or reset it. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | boolean | `false` |  | Blocks interaction and dims the control. Also set by a disabled fieldset. |
| `label` | `label` | string | `""` |  | An accessible name when the visible content is only an icon. |
| `busy` | `busy` | boolean | `false` |  | Shows a spinner and ignores clicks without disabling the button, so focus stays put. |
| `busy-text` | `busyText` | string | `""` |  | Replaces the label while busy. |
| `block` | `block` | boolean | `false` |  | Fills the width of its container. |
| `icon` | `icon` | boolean | `false` |  | A square icon-only button (give it a label). |
| `toggle` | `toggle` | boolean | `false` |  | A button that stays pressed: a click flips pressed. |
| `pressed` | `pressed` | boolean | `false` |  | The pressed state of a toggle button. |
| `value` | `value` | string | `""` |  | A value reported by pk-toggle. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | The label. |
| `start` | An icon before the label. |
| `end` | An icon after the label. |

**Events** (`addEventListener`; `pk-*` events are CustomEvents whose `detail` is shown)

| Event | Detail | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `click` | `native MouseEvent` | A click (not fired while disabled or busy). |
| `pk-toggle` | `{ pressed: boolean, value: string }` | A toggle button was pressed or released. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `focus()` | Focuses the inner button. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `control` | The inner button element. |
| `spinner` | The busy spinner. |
| `busy-text` | The text shown while busy. |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-button-bg` | `the variant colour` | Background colour. |
| `--pk-button-bg-hover` | `the variant hover colour` | Background colour on hover. |
| `--pk-button-fg` | `the variant text colour` | Text colour. |
| `--pk-button-radius` | `var(--radius-sm)` | Corner radius (a button group sets it to join its buttons). |
| `--pk-button-border` | `the variant border colour` | Border colour. |
| `--pk-button-padding` | `var(--space-2) var(--space-4); mini: 0.2rem 0.55rem` | Inner padding. |

**Accessibility.** A native button lives in the shadow root, so it is focusable, activates on Enter and Space and exposes the button role. Give an icon-only button a label. A toggle reports aria-pressed; a busy button reports aria-busy and ignores clicks without dropping focus. Focus ring and the 44px phone target are built in.

Example: Variants

```html
<pk-button>Save</pk-button>
<pk-button variant="ghost">Cancel</pk-button>
<pk-button variant="warn">Delete</pk-button>
<pk-button variant="secondary">Export</pk-button>
<pk-button variant="plain">Skip</pk-button>
```

Example: Sizes, block and disabled

```html
<pk-button size="lg">Large</pk-button>
<pk-button size="mini">Edit</pk-button>
<pk-button disabled>Locked</pk-button>
<pk-button block variant="secondary">Full width</pk-button>
```

Example: Busy, icon and toggle

```html
<pk-button busy busy-text="Saving...">Save</pk-button>
<pk-button icon variant="ghost" label="Add"><svg slot="start" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></pk-button>
<pk-button toggle variant="ghost" pressed>Bold</pk-button>
```

Example: Submits a form

```html
<form>
  <input name="q" required>
  <pk-button type="submit">Search</pk-button>
</form>
```

## `pk-button-group`

**Button group** (Actions). Buttons fused into one bar, horizontal, vertical or full width; with mode="single" its toggle buttons behave as one choice.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `orientation` | `orientation` | enum | `"horizontal"` | `horizontal` `vertical` | Direction of the bar. |
| `fill` | `fill` | boolean | `false` |  | Fills the container width and shares it between the buttons. |
| `label` | `label` | string | `""` |  | Accessible name of the group (aria-label). |
| `mode` | `mode` | enum | `"none"` | `none` `single` `multi` | single: the toggle buttons in the group release each other (one is always pressed); multi and none leave each toggle alone. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | pk-button elements. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `group` | The role=group container. |

**Accessibility.** role=group with an aria-label. In single mode the pressed state lives in each button's aria-pressed and the group keeps exactly one pressed. Buttons keep their 44px phone height.

Example: Group and single choice

```html
<pk-button-group label="View"><pk-button variant="ghost">Day</pk-button><pk-button variant="ghost">Week</pk-button><pk-button variant="ghost">Month</pk-button></pk-button-group>
<pk-button-group label="Density" mode="single"><pk-button toggle pressed variant="ghost">Compact</pk-button><pk-button toggle variant="ghost">Comfortable</pk-button></pk-button-group>
```

## `pk-split-button`

**Split button** (Actions). A main action beside a caret that opens a menu of related actions, so the common case is one click and the variants stay reachable.

It is form-associated (takes part in a `<form>` by its `name`) and delegates focus to its inner control.

**Props** (set as an attribute in kebab-case, or as a property in camelCase; a boolean is present or absent)

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `variant` | enum | `"primary"` | `primary` `ghost` | Colour of both halves. |
| `type` | `type` | enum | `"button"` | `button` `submit` `reset` | What the main action does inside a form. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | boolean | `false` |  | Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset. |
| `toggle-label` | `toggleLabel` | string | `"More options"` |  | Accessible name of the caret button. |
| `open` | `open` | boolean | `false` |  | Whether the menu is open. |
| `menu-align` | `menuAlign` | enum | `"start"` | `start` `end` | Which edge the menu lines up with. |

**Slots** (`slot="name"` on a child)

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | The main action label. |
| `menu` | The menu items: buttons (with a value or data-value). |

**Events** (`addEventListener`; `pk-*` events are CustomEvents whose `detail` is shown)

| Event | Detail | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `click` | `native MouseEvent` | The main action was clicked. |
| `pk-split-select` | `{ value: string, label: string }` | A menu item was chosen. |
| `pk-menu-toggle` | `{ open: boolean }` | The menu opened or closed. |

**Methods**

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `show()` | Opens the menu. |
| `hide()` | Closes the menu. |

**CSS parts** (`::part(name)`)

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `split` | The two buttons side by side. |
| `main` | The main action button. |
| `toggle` | The caret button. |
| `menu` | The menu panel. |

**CSS custom properties** (set on the element or a parent, from a stylesheet)

| Property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--pk-split-bg` | `the variant colour` | Background of both halves. |
| `--pk-split-fg` | `the variant text colour` | Text colour of both halves. |

**Accessibility.** The caret is a labelled menu button (aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded); the items get role=menuitem; ArrowDown/ArrowUp on the caret open the menu on the first/last item, arrows, Home and End move, Escape closes and returns focus to the caret, Tab closes, and a click outside closes. The menu opens upward when there is no room below.

Example: Primary and ghost

```html
<pk-split-button><span>Save</span><button slot="menu" value="close">Save and close</button><button slot="menu" value="new">Save and new</button></pk-split-button>
<pk-split-button variant="ghost" menu-align="end"><span>Export</span><button slot="menu" value="csv">CSV</button><button slot="menu" value="pdf">PDF</button></pk-split-button>
```
